Evidence and provenance kept for every step, with gates that refuse a silent loss, so a reviewer can retrace the work.

The concept behind it: [Audit trail](@/glossary/audit-trail.md).

Services that draw on it: [Digital forensics and evidence preservation](@/services/digital-forensics.md), [Decision support and AI agents for analysts](@/services/decision-support-ai.md) and [Governed AI-assisted software delivery](@/services/ai-engineering-governance.md).

Practised with: [HTML](@/glossary/html.md), [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md), [Alpine.js](@/glossary/alpine-js.md), [Flowbite Pro](@/glossary/flowbite-pro.md), [Playwright](@/glossary/playwright.md), [Python](@/glossary/python.md), [Tailwind CSS](@/glossary/tailwind-css.md) and [Claude API](@/glossary/claude-api.md).

Public work whose own words show it: [catharsis-as-a-service](https://github.com/korczis/catharsis-as-a-service), [llm](https://gitlab.com/korczis/llm) and [oscilla](https://github.com/korczis/oscilla).

It was applied in client work in Real-estate developer and Financial and investment group; the use cases below give the principle and the intent, without names or numbers.

How to read this page: the definition is the experience vocabulary's; the services, technologies, public [repositories](@/glossary/repository.md) and use cases are derived and each links to its page.
